name: whoopa-towne
description: Whoopa Towne - browser-based online multiplayer third-person shooter

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node tools/precompress.mjs && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
